The build passes now. Two real bugs hid in the warning noise, and they were sequential — the first one masked the second.

**Bug 1 — `src/core/options.js:6`**
The bump renamed the options key `retries` to `retryCount`. This call site still read `options.retries`, so it read `undefined` and threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. The fix accepts either key.

**Bug 2 — `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7`**
The new config loader leaves an unset flag as `undefined`. The old loader returned `false`. The strict check threw on `undefined`. The fix treats an unset flag as disabled, which matches the old default.

Result:

```
link ok: retry budget resolved to 3
link ok: exponential backoff disabled
build finished in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors
```

One thing I did not fix. The 8 warnings remain. They are deprecation notices from the bumped packages, for example `DEP0198 Buffer()` and `W1042 crypto.createCipher`. `build.js` prints them for files under `src/legacy`, `src/utils`, and `src/state`. Those files are not in this checkout, so I cannot change them here. The build is clean in the sense that it succeeds with 0 errors. If you want the warning count at zero too, point me at the real source tree for those modules.
